read.en: Zscaler slipped 0.4% on Nov 13 to $192.47, trading $187.56–197.43 on light volume (0.64x the 20-day average). It is below the 5-day ($194.7), 10-day ($204.8) and 30-day ($221.4), all falling, and above the rising 100-day ($184.8) and the 200-day ($166.6). MACD has been below its signal since Nov 2, below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 2 ($228.18), and RSI is 35.6.
read.zh: Zscaler 11月13日下跌 0.4%，收于 $192.47，盘中区间 $187.56–197.43，成交量偏低（20 日均量的 0.64 倍）。股价位于 5 日（$194.7）、10 日（$204.8）和 30 日均线（$221.4）下方，三者均在下行，同时位于上行的 100 日均线（$184.8）和 200 日均线（$166.6）上方。MACD 自 11月2日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方；抛物线 SAR 自 11月2日起看空（$228.18），RSI 为 35.6。

read.en: No level changed: the $197.43 high poked above $194.4–195.8 but the close slipped back under it, and the $187.56 low held the September lows. Resistance is $194.7–197.4 (5-day, Nov 13 high), then $201.6–204.8 (Nov 9–11 highs, 10-day) and $210.5 (Nov 6 high). Support is $187.5–188.9, then $184.6–184.8 (100-day, Nov 12 low) and $166.6 (200-day). A close above $197.4 would target $202–205; below $187.5, $184.6.

r.en: 5-day average $194.7; Sep 29 and Oct 2 lows ($195.1); Nov 9 low $195.80; Nov 13 high $197.43
